label: a
rationale: These batches share local-to-global topology for maps: the inverse-function and convexity batch develops local diffeomorphisms and open-map structure, while the covering-space batch develops local homeomorphisms, lifting, and global classification. Pairing the largest batch with the 39-item topology batch also avoids concentrating the reading load.

label: b
rationale: Both batches belong to the integration thread: elementary areas, multiple and improper integrals, and parameter dependence sit naturally beside the construction and basic calculus of measures. This keeps the measure-theory category whole and gives the Alpha a coherent 99-item assignment.

label: c
rationale: These batches use the same one-variable analytic toolkit: differentiation and integration, compactness of function families, trigonometric and complex exponentials, and convergent series connect the ODE and gauge-integral development to oscillatory examples and holomorphic analyticity. Real analysis has four batches and therefore cannot fit under the three-batch cap; this machinery-based split leaves a balanced 114-item assignment.
